page.description: elementary OS editions and architectures: compare, download official images, or prepare a USB with ROMinit CLI.
page.intro: An Ubuntu-based desktop Linux with its own Pantheon desktop and AppCenter. Pay-what-you-can model — enter $0 for free ISO access. Based on Ubuntu 24.04 LTS Noble Numbat with the HWE kernel stack.
pros: Ubuntu 24.04 LTS base with long support window (May 2034 ESM)
cons: Download URLs are expiring Cloudflare R2 redirects (3-day expiry)
No checksum sidecar file — SHA-256 only printed as text in the install guide
Not supported on Apple Silicon bare metal (VM only via UTM/Parallels)
No strict minimum requirements published; only recommendations
Download links are short-lived signed redirects that expire within days, so no stable per-file URL can be pinned; SHA-256 sums are published in the installation guide.
No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed, so this page is logo-only.
page.previewNote: No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed for elementary OS; the page shows the logo only. No image was written to a USB stick and nothing was booted.
page.status: Write the ISO to a USB stick with Etcher (4 GB+), boot, and follow the on-screen installer. Installing overwrites the selected disk.
